items.description: <p>In the country’s north, mining has ravaged Indigenous lands and lives for decades. items.title: Germany news: Parliament approves reforms giving pharmacies more autonomy on vaccinations, prescriptions, tests
items.description: Lawmakers passed a bill allowing pharmacies to issue certain prescription medications independently as well as to conduct more rapid tests. And bees besiege a Beetle in Düsseldorf's rush hour. DW has more.

items.title: Cyprus election expected to shake up national politics
items.description: Cyprus goes to the polls to elect a new parliament on May 24. The vote is expected to reshape the country's political landscape, weaken traditional parties and accelerate the rise of new anti-establishment movements.
